meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

howto.what: 当用户要求安装或配置NanoClaw时，此技能会让Claude引导用户运行`bash nanoclaw.sh`，该脚本自动完成依赖、容器镜像、凭据等设置；若中途出错，脚本会借助Claude辅助恢复并续跑。
howto.when: 当用户提到“setup”、“install”、“configure nanoclaw”等关键词，或要求安装、配置或首次设置NanoClaw时触发。

say.note: Claude会指导你运行安装脚本
脚本将自动完成依赖和凭据配置
Claude会引导你执行设置脚本

howto.what_en: When the user asks to install or configure NanoClaw, this skill instructs Claude to guide them to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`, which handles dependencies, container image, credentials, etc. If errors occur, the script offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions keywords like setup, install, configure nanoclaw, or requests first-time setup of NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you to run the setup script.
The script sets up dependencies and credentials.
Claude will lead you through the setup.
